edges_1_through_16: Driver reset asserted at sampling edge; PWM outputs low after NBA
edge_16_post_nba: startup[15] becomes 1; internal rst_n releases synchronously
edge_17: Both drivers begin reset-target pulse using old commanded angles and accept static clamped targets; command_sent becomes 1
next_frames: Clamped target PWM; exactly CLK_FREQ_HZ/50 cycles per frame
command_valid: High for exactly one sampling edge (17), no subsequent commands
clock_stopped: State holds; restart does not reinitialize; not a fail-safe guarantee
cdc: NONE; one clock and static elaborated commands
input_acceptance: Static clamped H/V targets sampled with shared valid once at edge17
output_completion: First reset PWM rising edge17; selected target PWM rising edge1000017 at50MHz
throughput: Fixed startup command once; PWM every20ms
reset_behavior: Configuration init holdlow edges1..16; release after edge16; no runtime reset
stall_behavior: No handshake; stopped clock holds state without reinitialization
error_behavior: Signed static target parameters saturated at mechanical bounds; invalidclock handled by unchanged driver
